summary: Iteration 6 partial — therapists `trained_on`, 5-message paywall for AI therapists, and Hope auto-voice import (expo-audio) — ALL VALIDATED. Backend pytest: 8/8 pass. action_items: Ship the planned auth + Stripe billing iteration so the paywall CTA (`cta_upgrade`, `cta_video`) is actually wired to checkout/booking flows. Backend currently only returns the paywall hint payload after 5 user turns; the frontend must consume it on POST /api/personas/chat responses (verify the persona-chat screen reads `paywall.limit_reached` and renders the upgrade sheet).
Bump expo, expo-font, expo-router to versions Expo CLI reports (54.0.35 / 14.0.12 / 6.0.24) — non-blocking but it logs on every restart.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~2174 lines. Recommend splitting into modules (therapists.py, personas.py, assessment.py, rehab_runner.py) — already flagged in prior iterations.

Persona chat response shape: when below the limit, `paywall` is returned as `null` (good — frontend should treat null OR missing as 'not yet'). Confirm persona-chat.tsx uses `data?.paywall?.limit_reached` truthiness check.
Paywall is purely advisory (server still calls the LLM and stores the turn). Once auth lands, enforce server-side: refuse the 6th+ user turn for non-premium users instead of just attaching a hint.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (Hope opener loads, Therapists tab shows 6 cards with trained_on, no red screen, no fatal console errors)
